## PPTX Player SDK – Play PowerPoint in the Browser

URL: https://207studio.dev/products/pptx-player-sdk/

Play PowerPoint in the browser with every animation: a client-side PPTX to HTML/SVG engine that works offline.

Client-side JS engine that plays .pptx click-by-click: build animations, morph, media, offline. No server, no Office. One-time $14, source included.

Tiers (USD, one-time):
- Developer: $14 - buy: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_75Don0VoNVcrgJ7mx9b32yZq5v4ZydBu37uwN1getXd
- Commercial: $129 - buy: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_6i0GKBLIeSNUMjqLDt8U9dAVfJxnGIrx7j5qf36gWcX

Developer is for one developer, and that includes shipping the player inside your own paid or free apps as bundled code. Commercial is for a company or organisation, where more than one person uses it, and adds priority email support. Neither lets you share the source itself. Both include the full source. One-time purchase.

## PadswayCore SDK: Mac-to-iPad Screen Streaming

URL: https://207studio.dev/products/padsway-core-sdk/

Put a live Mac screen on an iPad and send touch, keyboard, clipboard and dictation back: the streaming engine from a working Mac + iPad remote app, as a Swift package.

Swift package that streams a Mac screen to an iPad with hardware H.264/HEVC, 60/120 fps and touch, keyboard and clipboard back. Full source. One-time purchase.

Tiers (USD, one-time):

## Send Approval Gate MCP: Plan, Approve, Send, Verify

URL: https://207studio.dev/products/send-approval-gate-mcp/

An MCP server that makes an AI agent plan, present an exact hash-bound approval, send once and verify, and records every step.

Node.js 22+ MCP server (stdio) with six tools: status, account, contacts, plan-send, send and verify-send. The approval binds plan ID, account, recipient, message SHA-256, backend and environment hash. Duplicate sends are blocked, an uncertain result becomes result_unknown and is never retried, and every step goes to a local ledger with crash recovery. 47 tests, no npm dependencies.

Tiers (USD, one-time):
- Developer: $29 - buy: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_pisramo6U68y8MnVzhsf8GEGaI9YAIbFTQsHo34ITnm
- Commercial: $99 - buy: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_LlYHKLJekKIlUW6LAdcbOkqzpo9zA6FoBFqgz43kFXg

Developer: one developer, own projects only, no company use. Commercial: one organisation and its staff, including in its products as compiled or bundled code, with priority email support. One-time purchase. Commercial covers companies with annual revenue up to $1M. Above that, email support@207studio.dev for an Enterprise license.
